ingestion.validation_reason: Integration relies on the pending assumption of modern REST APIs from source systems.
ingestion.text: Data ingestion focuses on retrieving real-time shipment tracking and invoice data from existing internal systems. The Backend API Services (ARC_02) will orchestrate data retrieval via dedicated integration proxies (ARC_06, ARC_12). This process is critical for providing up-to-date information to the customer portal.

transactional_storage.validation_reason: Storage strategy is based on pending assumptions regarding customer volumes and authentication methods.
transactional_storage.text: The Customer Data Database (ARC_03) will serve as the primary transactional storage for customer account information. This includes user profiles and authentication details, supporting the portal's operational needs. Data volumes are assumed to be standard mid-market levels.

analytical_storage.validation_reason: No explicit customer requirement for analytical storage was stated; this is a recommendation for future capabilities.
analytical_storage.text: Currently, there are no explicit requirements for dedicated analytical storage. Operational logs from Monitoring and Logging (ARC_09) could serve as a foundational data source for future analytical needs. A separate analytical layer may be considered if reporting or business intelligence requirements emerge.

quality.validation_reason: Specific data quality rules and processes were not explicitly stated by the customer.
quality.text: Data quality will be maintained through validation at the point of ingestion and within the Backend API Services (ARC_02). Integration proxies (ARC_06, ARC_12) will perform basic schema and format checks. This ensures that data presented in the customer portal is accurate and reliable.

metadata_governance.validation_reason: No explicit customer requirement for metadata or governance was stated; this is a recommendation for good practice.
metadata_governance.text: A basic metadata strategy will involve documenting data sources, definitions, and ownership for key data domains. This will support understanding and managing the data assets within the new portal. Formal governance processes can be established as the solution matures.

retention.validation_reason: Specific data retention periods for customer and operational data were not provided by the customer.
retention.text: Data retention policies will be defined for all data stored in the Customer Data Database (ARC_03). These policies will address how long customer account data and associated operational logs are kept. Specific retention periods require customer validation.

privacy_security.validation_reason: Security measures are based on a pending assumption regarding standard web security and authentication practices.
privacy_security.text: Data privacy and security will adhere to standard web security practices, including data encryption in transit and at rest. User Authentication and Authorization (ARC_04) will manage access, while a Web Application Firewall (ARC_11) and Virtual Private Cloud (ARC_08) provide network protection. Secrets Management (ARC_10) will secure sensitive credentials.

reporting_analytics.validation_reason: No explicit customer requirement for reporting or analytics was stated; this is a recommendation for future consideration.
reporting_analytics.text: The initial scope does not include dedicated reporting or analytics capabilities for the customer portal. The focus is on providing direct access to operational data. Future phases could introduce reporting features based on collected portal usage and customer interaction data.

backup_recovery.validation_reason: Specific RTO/RPO objectives and backup frequencies were not explicitly stated by the customer.
backup_recovery.text: A comprehensive backup and recovery strategy will be implemented for the Customer Data Database (ARC_03). This includes regular backups and a defined recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO). The strategy ensures data durability and business continuity for the portal.
